Subscribe

Add these hours to your own calendar so changes sync automatically:

  • Apple Calendar / Outlook — subscribe to the iCal feed: https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/TODO_CALENDAR_ID/public/basic.ics

The week before a deadline fills up fast. If you need a slot then, come early in the week rather than the day before.
